categories.name: Release A
categories.description: Represents the standard discharge pathway (Release A) for an admitted patient, helping to avoid post-discharge deterioration and measured against post-discharge ER returns.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release A (id=17) which is observed in multiple narrative variants (e.g. V0008, V0065, V0070) concluding normal inpatient care pathways.

categories.name: Release B
categories.description: Represents discharge pathway B for an admitted patient, contributing to avoiding post-discharge deterioration and monitored via post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release B (id=18) observed in rare and extended inpatient recovery variants such as V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release C
categories.description: Represents discharge pathway C for an admitted patient, aligning with long-term inpatient care outcomes and post-discharge stability.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release C (id=19) which is realized in long-running complex variants such as V0710.

categories.name: Release D
categories.description: Represents discharge pathway D for an admitted patient, contributing to avoidance of post-discharge deterioration.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release D (id=20) observed in length-high diagnostic variants like V0273.

categories.name: Release E
categories.description: Represents discharge pathway E for an admitted patient, targeting safe discharge transitions.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release E (id=21) based on the goal-model decomposition axis.

categories.name: Release F
categories.description: Represents discharge pathway F for an admitted patient, concluding the inpatient treatment trajectory.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative Release F (id=112) based on the goal-model decomposition axis.
